objective: Let authorized users search and page beyond 100 registered sources and 25 analysis rows, including selecting an older source for analysis, without changing existing v1 list behavior, source/result/command identities, module-owned persistence, permission scope, or the current Veyviz visual/action behavior.
explicitlyOutOfScope: No future shared UI package, navigation, product branding, command-state, draft/conflict, login/logout, React, or browser-profile adoption. Those remain in the later framework-adoption plan.
No Python/model execution changes or real inference tests; use only owner/product test fixtures and the existing deterministic test-only runner double.
No new recording ingestion, live cameras, stream processing, detections, data ownership, or cross-owner SQL.
No modification to v1 list operation or route shapes/limits; pagination is additive under new operation IDs and routes.
No database reseeding, local user/grant modification, deployment, external service, or changes to the original repositories.

request.cursor: Optional opaque string; maximum 512 characters. Cursor is bound to normalized query, tenant, product and instance plus the stable last-row key. It is only a bounded page position, never a permission/grant and never a snapshot-consistency guarantee.
request.search: Optional trimmed query string; maximum 200 characters; parameterized literal matching only over fields named for that owner below. No SQL fragments, arbitrary sort keys or wildcard execution input.

response.page: Closed object with `limit`, optional `nextCursor`, and coverage `filtered-owner-query`; never a guessed tenant-wide total or total page count.

rules: Every page re-runs the current authenticated RequestContext permission assertion and tenant/product/instance predicates; a cursor grants no access.
Reject malformed cursors and cursors whose query/scope binding differs from the supplied request. Changing search/filter/limit clears the UI cursor stack.
Use deterministic keyset order `created DESC, id ASC` with a unique-ID tie break; do not use unbounded OFFSET or load the old capped list then filter it in memory.
Rows inserted, renamed or otherwise changed between page requests may shift membership. State that no cross-page snapshot is promised; do not claim stable snapshot pagination.

sourceOwner.method: query(ctx, {q?, renamedOnly?, limit?, cursor?}) -> {items: SourceView[], page}
sourceOwner.operation: veyviz-sources.sources.query, descriptor version 1, closed bounded input/output schemas
sourceOwner.compatibility: Keep the existing `veyviz.sources.read.v1` list/get methods and `veyviz-sources.sources.list` operation v1 plus GET /api/sources response `{items}` with its existing maximum of 100. Do not make `list()` silently unbounded or change its output.

filters.q: Analysis ID, job ID or source ID only; source-name matching is supplied by the separate source picker query, not by reading the source database.

analysisOwner.compatibility: Keep `veyviz-analysis.analysis.list` v1 and GET /api/analysis behavior/response and existing 25-row maximum. The UI may migrate to the new query route; current v1 consumers must continue to work unchanged. New query projections retain captured source ID/version, actual job/review states, counts and truthful coverage fields.

analysisSourcePicker.newOperation: veyviz-analysis.sources.query, descriptor version 1, input/output matching the bounded SourceQuery page contract
analysisSourcePicker.routePermission: veyviz.analysis.read; the delegated source query also requires the original actor's current veyviz.sources.read permission in the source owner.
analysisSourcePicker.port: Add an explicit `veyviz.sources.query.v1` source-query service and an `AnalysisPorts.sourcesQuery` method. Analysis invokes it through the existing static solution binding and a context derived for the original actor, product, instance, tenant and request. No analysis SQL joins or reads source tables.
analysisSourcePicker.wireChanges: Declare the query contract in the sources module `provides` and analysis module `requires`; add a distinct reviewed source-query binding to veyviz-review and its fixed source choice/binding implementation in solutions/veyviz. veyviz-catalog selects only veyviz-sources, so its source-owned query route needs no analysis module, analysis binding or worker. Do not repurpose veyviz.sources.read.v1 to add an undeclared method.

uiBehavior: Replace client-only filtering of the first 100/25 rows with the owner query routes. Keep existing dark Command Center/light Investigate visual design, actual sample viewer, filmstrip, review actions, cancel action, provenance panel and read-only controls.

Recordings gets bounded name/ID search plus Previous/Next controls. The analysis source picker searches source names/IDs through `/api/analysis/sources/query`, so an older source can be selected without an analysis-to-source DB join. The analysis list filters by exact selected sourceId and its own declared analysis fields.

Investigate's free-text label must not promise source-name search over unqueried sources; use owner-supported analysis/job/source IDs and explicit recording selection. Source-name search belongs in the source-owned picker.

Show current page and whether another page exists, not a tenant total. Keep a bounded prior-cursor stack for Previous. Reset cursor/page state when filters change. Guard delayed query responses with request epochs so old filter/page results cannot replace the current page or its selected accepted result.

After registration or rename, refresh the relevant owner query and preserve current receipt, focus and existing user message. The source/analysis mutations themselves, original command IDs, data shapes and result version checks are outside this paging change.

Test invalid/oversized query/limit/cursor, cross-tenant cursor replay, cursor replay under changed q/filter/limit, permission denial on each page and permission revocation between pages. Assert no source rows leak through analysis when either required read permission is absent.

Use at least 31 analysis rows across multiple job/review/source/date states with the existing deterministic test-only runner or owner fixtures; locate rows after old 25 boundary, exercise every supported filter and stable next/previous page behavior without invoking Python or real model inference.

Verify exact v1 source/analysis operation outputs, route output and limits remain unchanged; verify the new operation descriptors reject additional/invalid query fields and return the closed v2 page shape.
